text: Access Now has written to four pension funds urging them to examine their exposure to AE Industrial Partners, which acquired spyware vendor Paragon Solutions in 2024 and merged it with surveillance contractor REDLattice.

Privacy International submitted a response to the UK government's consultation on workplace monitoring technologies, raising concerns about the expanding use of employer surveillance tools and calling for clearer legal limits on how workers can be tracked.

Freedom House has adopted the case of Tatiana Kouzina, a Belarusian civil society researcher imprisoned by the Lukashenka government, which the organization describes as systematically imprisoning independent experts and dissenting voices to eliminate credible sources of information outside state control.

Apple has sent threat notifications to users it suspects have been targeted by spyware since 2021, alerting them via email, iMessage, and account banners — a system Access Now has documented as a key tool for identifying state-sponsored spyware campaigns against journalists, activists, and others.
